## 3dslibris 2.9.0

I'm coming back from a long hiatus (hi holidays) with a new release that fixes some long-standing issues and adds a few new features. I hope you enjoy it!

More reliable text pagination and alignment, finer publisher-margin controls, lower memory usage when reopening large MOBI books, natural CBZ page ordering, and corrected CIA banner audio.

### Improvements

* Keep the current PDF display list when changing zoom, avoiding another interpretation of the same page.

* Reduce integer divisions when scaling CBZ pages for the interactive view, preserving the same nearest-neighbor pixels.

* Reuse the current PDF page display list between the preview and zoom view, avoiding repeated document interpretation.

* Avoid reading and decoding CBZ pages twice before showing them: synchronous preview and zoom views now share the decoded image.

* Added debug-only PDF and CBZ timing logs for opening, decoding, rendering, scaling and page presentation, with memory snapshots to help investigate slow documents.

* Updated the CIA HOME Menu sound with a short intro, trimmed and faded to fit the three-second stereo banner limit.

* Reduced peak memory usage when reopening large MOBI books: page caches up to 16 MiB retain the fast bulk-read path, while larger caches are loaded incrementally from storage.
* Split publisher margins into separate vertical spacing (`publisher spacing`) and side-margin (`publisher sides`) controls, available globally and per book. Books can keep publisher vertical spacing while disabling side margins.

### Bug Fixes

* Prepare fixed-layout workers synchronously before HOME/sleep, without blocking joins or freeing their resources inside the APT hook. Cleanup runs after resume. This addresses lifecycle hazards; the HOME Menu crash reported in #68 is still under investigation.

* Wait for PDF strip rendering to finish before releasing its pixels or display list when cancelling or changing pages.

* Preserve positive publisher vertical margins between blocks, including `1em` gaps that were previously consumed by the paragraph line break.
* #139: fixed text disappearing between pages when a long paragraph crossed reading screens with different heights. Pagination now uses each screen's limits and starts at the same text baseline as the renderer.
* #142: load embedded XHTML `<style>` blocks as well as linked stylesheets, so their alignment and publisher margins reach the page layout. Older EPUB page caches are rebuilt automatically.
* #142: fixed centered and right-aligned text reverting to left alignment after the first line. Alignment now applies to each line while preserving intentional blank lines, including across screens and pages.
* #151: corrected the CIA HOME Menu banner audio to stereo. Added checks for the channel count and duration required by the banner format (my fault not reading the docs heh).
* #152: fixed CBZ chapters and pages being sorted alphabetically instead of numerically, so `Chapter 5` comes before `Chapter 10` and `2.png` comes before `10.png`, including inside nested folders.
